purpose: Pre-register one novel finite-lag cross-physics feature family and a source-corrected broad Stage-1 residual mask before any H53 holdout scoring.
target_and_limitation: Competition target is fault pixels. Labels are the visible known-fault catalogue, so six-block scores are proxies and cannot validate genuinely unknown organizer labels or geothermal-vent discovery.

candidate.name: Finite-lag cross-physics edge pairing
candidate.physical_signature: At each detrended-elevation edge, a similarly oriented gravity edge 1-8 pixels (100-800 m) away on either side, compared with a zero-lag control; two Gaussian scales (sigma=2,5 px).
candidate.missing_fault_rationale: A subdued surface break and a subsurface density/basement contrast may be spatially offset by basin cover or structure. This is a structural hypothesis, not proof; lithologic contacts and processing offsets are confounds.
candidate.difference_from_prior_code: H-X1 is magnetic/gravity zero-offset orientation concordance; H-E includes broad co-located basement/gravity/conductivity cues; H-H detects potential-field edge endpoints and relay bridges; K1 is scale-persistent tilt-like phase. None implements a bounded nonzero signed surface-to-gravity edge lag.
candidate.expected_benefit: Qualitatively moderate and uncertain; no numeric forecast.
candidate.implementation_cost: Medium; existing pinned competition raster bands, one transform family, six blocked model folds.
candidate.external_data: None beyond the hash-pinned owner mirror; no new external download required.

stage1.role: Coarse tile prior and allowed domain only; never a fine-scale locator.
stage1.formula: E_dot_ij = 1/2 sum_k [L_k*u_dot_k/(A_tile*sin(delta_k))]*(n_i*m_j+n_j*m_i); predicted tile dilation and source-defined shear are summarized from the summed horizontal tensor.
stage1.source: Kreemer et al. (2000), Eq. 3; official-source review knowledge/official-source-review-20261007.md.
stage1.geometry: Original official INGENIOUS QFaults vertices projected to EPSG:32611; segment lengths clipped to each tile before summation.

nominal_assumptions.slip_rate_unit: mm/year, verified from official DBF field definition
nominal_assumptions.geodetic_rate_scale: literal 10E-9/year = 1E-8/year for numeric conversion; source notation is treated literally
nominal_assumptions.residuals: r_dil = observed_dilatation - predicted_dilatation/1E-8; r_shear = observed_shear - predicted_shear/1E-8
nominal_assumptions.prior: equal-weight mean of empirical rank(r_dil) and rank(r_shear) over valid tiles; approve the top 90% (q10 threshold)

stage1.fold_leakage_control: For each 3x3 spatial holdout fold, exclude an entire official trace record if any one of its clipped segments intersects the held-out block before computing the Stage-1 tile prior.
stage1.separate_holdout: Five fixed whole-record splits. Freeze groups as sorted unique official record_id values permuted with NumPy default_rng(5308).permutation and divided with numpy.array_split into five equal groups; hold out one group and remove those whole records from the budget. Report approved tile area, held-out visible catalogue pixel recall, recall/area lift, and matched-mass uniform-in-approved versus uniform-in-footprint DTI separately from Stage 2. The matched-mass DTI uses 3.47 times held-out raster pixels and random seed 5300 + split_index; one draw per condition is descriptive, not a precise effect estimate.
stage1.stage2_seed_and_cache_provenance: Canonical fresh-fit negative sampling is RNG seed 1000 + fold.index, per scripts/run_experiments.py and the prior H51-K1 preregistration. H52's h52_field_* caches use 2000 + fold.index and are a distinct experiment. The frozen H-H/H-D blend receipt loads legacy field_H_H_fold* / field_H_D_fold* caches whose exact generating command, seeds, software/data hashes, and field files are not preserved; do not substitute either cache family or claim reproduction without the locked baseline audit passing. Candidate Stage-2 scoring is blocked if the fresh canonical H-D/H-H STE baseline does not reproduce the frozen mean within 1e-5.

stage2.protocol: Six contiguous 3x3 spatial blocks; 12-pixel training buffer; 250000 negatives per fold; fixed seeds; scoring only within the held-out block.
stage2.baseline: Fresh H-D and H-H fields, fixed 50/50 arithmetic probability blend, STE L9 continuity=0.35 spacing=2.4 px, mass ratio=3.47, published-catalogue exclusion radius=2 px.
stage2.candidate: Add only H53-A features to the H-H arm and keep H-D unchanged; arithmetic 50/50 blend; same training folds, emission and mass as baseline.
stage2.stage1_gate: Fold-specific source-corrected tile prior, q10 approved mask; all Stage-2 predictions must be inside it.
stage2.features: At sigma=2 and 5 px, compute mask-normalized gradients of detrended elevation and isostatic gravity. Rank-normalize nonzero gradient magnitudes over valid footprint pixels. For each surface-edge normal compare zero-lag edge-normal agreement and the maximum gravity edge response at distances 1-8 px on either side. Six frozen inputs: zero-lag co-edge response, max-offset co-edge response, winning lag/8 at each of the two scales. Invalid support remains missing; no label enters the transforms.
stage2.promotion: Fresh ungated baseline reproduces 0.285340602656319 within 1e-5; candidate q10-gated mean exceeds frozen mean and same-fold gated baseline; candidate wins >=4/6 folds; approved area >=2/3; Stage-1 lift <=1.5; every emitted point inside q10 mask. No post-result tuning or rerun.
stage2.metric_truth: Visible known-fault catalogue proxy, not hidden organizer truth; local DTI is not a DrivenData score.

artifact_policy.failed_candidate: May produce a unique research-only diagnostic TIFF, explicitly labelled DOWNLOAD FOR RESEARCH: YES; SUBMIT: NO.
artifact_policy.passed_candidate: May produce a named local upload candidate after format, scoped uniqueness and non-dominance checks; no portal acceptance or score claim absent organizer validation.
artifact_policy.format: Single-band float32; exact sample-submission CRS, shape and transform; every pixel finite in [0,1]; zeros outside footprint; no NoData tag.
artifact_policy.uniqueness: Compare final bytes/support with all available same-grid local, archived, and pinned sibling reference TIFFs; report scope and any containment failure.
artifact_policy.slot: No competition submission/weekly slot is authorized or consumed by local work.
